name: Camera Model with Radial/Tangential Distortion
definition: A camera model that supports intrinsic parameters (focal length, principal point, skew, aspect ratio) and lens distortion (radial and tangential), used to convert between pixel coordinates and 3D world rays/points.
summary: This camera model maps 2D pixels to 3D rays using pinhole intrinsics and lens distortion, distinguished by an iterative undistortion step to recover ideal coordinates.
